title: Recipe
description: A hearty and aromatic vegan stew inspired by the warm spices of a desert oasis. Sweet root vegetables, chickpeas, and apricots simmer in a fragrant broth, creating a 'super' comforting dish perfect for a cold winter's night. The pomegranate 'crystals' on top add a burst of freshness.
name: Golden Dune Winter Stew

other.name: sweet potatoes
other.notes: medium, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions.description: Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper. Stir constantly and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the sweet potatoes and carrots to the pot, stirring to coat them in the spices. Cook for 3-4 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and diced tomatoes. Add the chopped dried apricots. Season with salt and pepper. Stir everything together and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for 25-30 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes and carrots are tender.
While the stew simmers, prepare the couscous according to package instructions. Fluff with a fork and set aside.
Stir the rinsed chickpeas and fresh lemon juice into the stew. Cook for another 5 minutes to heat through. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.
To serve, create a 'nest' of fluffy couscous in each bowl. Ladle the stew generously over the top. Garnish with fresh cilantro and a sprinkle of pomegranate 'crystals'.

notes: This stew is fantastic for meal prep as the flavors deepen overnight. For an extra layer of texture, you can add a handful of slivered almonds as a garnish. Feel free to substitute butternut squash for the sweet potatoes.
